title: Reward rate dilution via flash loan stake attack
description: An attacker can use flash loans to temporarily inflate the totalStaked amount during reward distribution calculations. By borrowing a large amount of tokens, staking them, triggering reward accrual, and then unstaking and repaying the loan within a single transaction, the attacker can capture a disproportionate share of rewards without actual capital commitment.
impact: Disproportionate reward capture by flash loan attackers at the expense of legitimate stakers. The attack can be repeated across multiple blocks to systematically drain rewards meant for long-term participants.
attackPath: Obtain flash loan for large amount of staking tokens
Stake the borrowed tokens to inflate totalStaked
Unstake tokens and capture accrued rewards
recommendation: Implement snapshot-based reward calculations that use historical stake amounts rather than current values. Consider adding a minimum lock period or using time-weighted average balances for reward distribution.
